name: Old Course Champion Jean

intro.text: The eighteenth. Over the Swilcan Bridge, up to the Valley of Sin in front of the green, and the whole town watching from the railings. Let's give them a show.

win: That's the round. Off you go and stand on the bridge for your photograph. Everybody does.
